text:
Marta Lopez: quick find from usability testing: in the vector preview table the tiny icon-only Export button is easy to miss and has poor contrast on hover. participants thought it was a tag, not an action.
Samir Patel: is this the row action or the header export? we have both.
Marta Lopez: row action. header is fine. row action is icon-only (download arrow), sits left of the kebab menu.
Jade O'Connor: can we try label-on-hover vs persistent label? icon-only keeps density but hurts discoverability. maybe a compact label that expands on hover/focus.
Noah Chen: technical notes: expanding label on hover is doable with width animation, but keyboard focus should expose the label too (not just hover). also ensure the clickable hit target remains 44px min.
A11y QA: screen reader note: icon-only buttons need aria-labels. right now the export icon has aria-label="export" which is generic. suggest aria-label="Download vector as CSV" and role="button" is fine. also ensure focus order is logical (checkbox -> primary actions -> kebab).
Samir Patel: UX trade: adding persistent labels increases row height and reduces density for large batches. suggestion: show text label on focus/hover and provide a keyboard shortcut (D) to download selected rows. add a tooltip that includes the shortcut: "Download (D)".
Marta Lopez: copy suggestion: use "Download selected vectors" rather than "Export" or "Download CSV" in the tooltip. keep the button label short if persisted: "Download".
Jade O'Connor: mobile concern: hover doesn't exist. on narrow screens we should collapse to kebab-only and surface Download in contextual menu with clear icons and labels.
Noah Chen: implementation checklist: 1) make export button aria-label more descriptive; 2) ensure focus exposes text via sr-only or visible expansion; 3) add keyboard shortcut D with accessible announcement when used (aria-live polite: "Downloading 3 selected vectors"); 4) update hit target to 44px; 5) adjust visual contrast to AA for hover state.
A11y QA: also test with NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver and iOS VoiceOver. confirm announcement sequence: when user presses D, announce selection count then "Downloading". avoid double announcements from both the shortcut handler and the native download.
Samir Patel: small UI question: should the keyboard shortcut be global in the console or scoped to the vectors table? scoped is safer. show a tiny shortcut hint in the table toolbar: "Download (D)".
Marta Lopez: toolbar hint is great. also change table column header from "Score" to "Relevance score" for clarity in export CSV headers.
Jade O'Connor: rerank context: when user triggers Rerank from row, we currently open a modal that lacks context of original rank. add a small "Before" / "After" chip and make modal title "Rerank sample — preview changes". aria-live region should announce "Rerank preview applied" when changes are simulated.
Noah Chen: backend note: CSV export should include both original_index and current_order fields to avoid ambiguity downstream. add headers: original_index, current_index, id, vector_norm, relevance_score.
DesignBot: Created issue #4999: "Vectors preview: row export discoverability, keyboard shortcut, CSV headers, mobile fallback" and assigned to Samir Patel. :white_check_mark:
A11y QA: i'll attach a quick test matrix to #4999 and add Pass/Fail rows for each screen reader + keyboard scenario.
Marta Lopez: i'll mock the focused-label microinteraction and a compact toolbar hint. uploading mocks by tomorrow morning. thanks!
